title: EXAMCELL AUTOMATION SYSTEM
tagline: High-Integrity Examination Hall & Matrix Seating Engine
problem: Manual examination seating across multi-department batches caused frequent subject collisions, underutilized hall capacities, and error-prone paper workflows during institutional examinations.
solution: Built an automated matrix seating engine in Django & PostgreSQL that normalizes student enrollments into 1:1 subject records, enforces deterministic anti-cheating distribution, and produces verifiable PDF/Excel seating plans in seconds.
architectureHighlight: Matrix Bench Allocation & Constraint Propagation: Models hall benches as discrete coordinate matrices (row × column × seat slot). Implements a dual-tier greedy allocation algorithm enforcing deterministic inter-department interleaving so no two adjacent students share the same exam paper while strictly respecting hall capacity limits.

title: CORE COMMERCE SERVICE
tagline: Transactional Backend Engine with Strict Concurrency & Isolation
problem: High-concurrency checkout spikes frequently cause inventory overselling, race conditions between simultaneous shoppers, and orphaned database states when cart sessions drop mid-payment.
solution: Engineered a resilient Django commerce backend enforcing ACID database transactions with row-level locks, soft-deletion patterns for audit trails, and strict role-based access control between customer and administrative portals.
architectureHighlight: Row-Level Lock Concurrency (SELECT FOR UPDATE): Leverages PostgreSQL row-level locks within atomic transaction blocks during inventory reservation, eliminating race conditions under simultaneous checkout attempts without the operational overhead of an external distributed locking service.

title: SYSTEMS & ALGORITHMS LAB
tagline: Performance Benchmarks, C Memory Patterns & Python Internals
problem: High-level backend development often creates hidden performance bottlenecks when developers treat memory layouts and algorithmic complexity as black boxes.
solution: Curated an in-depth 9-tier systems and backend engineering repository documenting low-level C memory patterns, pointer arithmetic, cache-conscious data structures, and production Python profiling.
architectureHighlight: Cache-Conscious Data Structures & Memory Profiling: Analyzes pointer arithmetic and memory layout differences between C and Python, demonstrating how memory alignment, __slots__, and generator pipelines drastically reduce garbage collection pauses and RAM overhead in high-throughput services.
